featured_reviews.name: Avi Maru
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid Asian Motors Bhayandar at all costs.
Bought Hero Xtreme 125R BS6 Phase 2 in November 2025. 7 issues in 6 months on a brand new motorcycle:
Bike jerking at 3500-4500 RPM since day one — ignored for 6 months across multiple services until I forcefully escalated
Promised accessories withheld at delivery — rear hugger, bike cover delayed across 3-4 visits, rusted nuts used on number plate
Clutch assembly nuts coming loose every 200-300km on a 1951km motorcycle — critical safety defect
Bluetooth connectivity — gave completely wrong technical explanation showing zero product knowledge
ABS sensor, cruise control and check engine light all non-functional at delivery — needed external engineer to diagnose
Extremely hard gearbox — only fixed after excessive escalation
Bike geometry dangerously messed up after service — loose steering head bearing causing instability at all speeds, potential tank slapper risk
Salesperson denied PDI at delivery. Service center consistently dismissive and incompetent.
Formally escalating to Hero MotoCorp customer care. Consumer court is next step if unresolved.
I have documented evidence of all issues mentioned above

featured_reviews.name: Ashutosh Agnihotri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apart from usual ifs and buts, they are marvelously humble ans assisting people when it comes to letting you know what issues your vehicle is going through and what amount will be required to fix it. The beautiful part is that they have as good a sense of hospitality as any five star hotel. Also, you find the professionals here to treat your bike like a doctor treats a patient. Their knowledge of mechanical parts, instruments, possible issues, their costs, and the best suggestions to keep in mind while driving are so outstanding.
I read few reviews about the cost; don't know what went wrong for those customers, but I can let you know my experience that even if I had missed a servicing by a small margin and my term would have lost, they considered it and allowed us their service regardless of delay respecting that we had paid.
So, overall, my experience is good and I am a regular customer who trusts no one else for my vehicle but this place. I recommend it totally.

featured_reviews.name: Subhasish Mallick
featured_reviews.review_text:
The most unfavorable location to purchase a motorcycle.

I have come to realize that while riding on the highway, the motorcycle ceased functioning automatically just one day after I bought it. Subsequently, I made numerous requests to return the motorcycle for a reduced price, but my requests were denied. I continue to experience the same issue, where the engine stops while driving on the highway, despite having a full tank of fuel.

They merely apply paint to the exterior and sell the motorcycles. One might perceive that the condition of the motorcycle is excellent upon inspection, but in reality, it is not in good condition.

In my opinion, I would not recommend purchasing a second-hand motorcycle from this agency.

You are well aware of the date when I made my purchase from you. You are acquiring bikes directly from the owner in satisfactory condition, and subsequently, you are swapping parts from a bike in good condition to one in poor condition, and vice versa. As a result, the bike in good condition becomes compromised, as was the case with my bike. You sold me a bike with damaged components:
1. The mileage meter is not functioning correctly,
2. The fuel meter is inoperative,
3. A damaged clutch plate was installed along with the belt,
4. The horn is damaged,
5. There is no engine oil,
6. The rear wheel brake shoe is damaged.

For these reasons, I have visited his premises more than three times for servicing, but he has only addressed the fuel meter and the rear wheel brake shoe.
